name: sabbatical_request_policy_exception_case
use_case: Handle leave request boundaries such as insufficient balance, overlaps, or exceptions via HR case
branch: An employee inquires about taking a 3-month sabbatical leave, which is not an automated leave type and requires opening a policy exception HR case.
tests: Creates a policy exception HR case for an employee requesting a 3-month sabbatical leave.
instruction:
You want to take a 3-month sabbatical leave starting next spring to participate in an overseas research fellowship. You know sabbaticals are not standard automated leave types in the system and require a policy exception case. You want the assistant to open an HR case with category policy_exception.

Your details:
- Employee ID: E430
- Name: Elena Rostova
- Region: US
- Request: 3-month sabbatical leave
- Case Category: policy_exception
- Subject: Sabbatical leave exception request

persona.name: Elena Rostova
persona.initial_message: Hello, I would like to request a 3-month sabbatical leave and open a policy exception case for HR review.
